PRESCRIBER_ORG.expr: pick(['Cedar Ridge','Lakeshore','Bluebonnet','Riverbend','Summit','Harbor View','Prairie','Magnolia','Pinecrest','Northgate','Silver Creek','Brookside','Granite Peak','Oak Hollow','Bayfront','Sunridge','Willow Park','Mesa Verde','Highland','Clearwater','Stonebridge','Evergreen','Red River','Juniper','Maple Grove','Canyon','Liberty','Crescent','Heritage','Coastal']) + ' ' + {'Health System': pick(['Health','Health System','Medical Group','Physicians Network']), 'Ambulatory Clinic': pick(['Family Medicine','Primary Care','Internal Medicine','Community Clinic']), 'Specialty Practice': pick(['Rheumatology','Oncology Associates','Endocrinology','Behavioral Health','Dermatology']), 'Long-Term & Post-Acute Care': pick(['Senior Care','Rehab Center','Skilled Nursing']), 'Urgent Care': pick(['Urgent Care','Express Care'])}[actor['ORG_TYPE']] + ' (' + {'New York':'NY','Pennsylvania':'PA','Massachusetts':'MA','New Jersey':'NJ','Connecticut':'CT','Florida':'FL','Georgia':'GA','North Carolina':'NC','Tennessee':'TN','Virginia':'VA','Illinois':'IL','Ohio':'OH','Michigan':'MI','Minnesota':'MN','Missouri':'MO','Texas':'TX','Arizona':'AZ','New Mexico':'NM','Oklahoma':'OK','California':'CA','Washington':'WA','Colorado':'CO','Oregon':'OR'}[actor['STATE']] + ')'

columns.name: _RX
columns.expr: 1 if r['TRANSACTION_TYPE'] in ('NewRx', 'RxRenewal', 'CancelRx', 'RxChange') else 0

columns.name: _CLS
columns.expr: weighted({'Diabetes & GLP-1': 12, 'Cardiovascular': 16, 'Behavioral Health': 11, 'Respiratory': 9, 'Anti-infectives': 10, 'Thyroid': 6, 'Pain (non-opioid)': 7, 'Opioid Analgesics': 6, 'ADHD Stimulants': 4, 'Benzodiazepines': 3, 'Specialty: Immunology': 5 if actor['ORG_TYPE'] != 'Specialty Practice' else 22, 'Specialty: Oncology': 2 if actor['ORG_TYPE'] != 'Specialty Practice' else 14, 'Dermatology': 4}) if (r['_RX'] or r['TRANSACTION_TYPE'] == 'Prior Authorization') else None

columns.name: THERAPEUTIC_CLASS
columns.expr: r['_CLS'] if r['_CLS'] else 'Not drug-specific'

columns.name: SPECIALTY_MEDICATION
columns.expr: 'Yes' if (r['_CLS'] or '').startswith('Specialty') else 'No'

columns.name: CONTROLLED_SUBSTANCE
columns.expr: 'Yes' if r['_CLS'] in ('Opioid Analgesics', 'ADHD Stimulants', 'Benzodiazepines') else 'No'

columns.name: PHARMACY
columns.expr: (('Specialty Pharmacy' if r['SPECIALTY_MEDICATION'] == 'Yes' and chance(0.85) else weighted({'CVS Pharmacy': 24, 'Walgreens': 20, 'Walmart Pharmacy': 12, 'Kroger': 7, 'Independent Pharmacy': 18, 'Publix': 4 if actor['REGION'] == 'Southeast' else 0.5, 'H-E-B': 9 if actor['STATE'] == 'Texas' else 0.2, 'Mail Order': 7}))) if r['_RX'] else 'Not routed to pharmacy'

columns.name: _NAV
columns.expr: 1 if r['PBM'] == 'Navitus' else 0

columns.name: _DAYSAGO
columns.expr: (as_of - d).days

columns.name: NEW_RX
columns.expr: 1 if r['TRANSACTION_TYPE'] == 'NewRx' else 0

columns.name: EPCS_RX
columns.expr: 1 if (r['NEW_RX'] and r['CONTROLLED_SUBSTANCE'] == 'Yes') else 0

columns.name: RTPB_CHECKS
columns.expr: (1 if chance(min(0.95, (0.27 + 0.5 * ramp(270)) if r['_NAV'] else actor['_RTPB'] * (0.9 + 0.2 * r['_PROG'])) ) else 0) if r['NEW_RX'] else 0

columns.name: ALTERNATIVES_PRESENTED
columns.expr: (1 if chance(0.3 if r['SPECIALTY_MEDICATION'] == 'Yes' else 0.17) else 0) if r['RTPB_CHECKS'] else 0

columns.name: ALTERNATIVES_SELECTED
columns.expr: (1 if chance(0.42 + (0.18 * ramp(270) if r['_NAV'] else 0)) else 0) if r['ALTERNATIVES_PRESENTED'] else 0

columns.name: PATIENT_SAVINGS_USD
columns.expr: (lognorm(780, 0.45) if r['SPECIALTY_MEDICATION'] == 'Yes' else lognorm(58, 0.65)) if r['ALTERNATIVES_SELECTED'] else 0.0

columns.name: PATIENT_OOP_USD
columns.expr: max(0.0, (lognorm({'Specialty: Immunology': 420, 'Specialty: Oncology': 520, 'Diabetes & GLP-1': 55, 'Dermatology': 40}.get(r['_CLS'], 14), 0.9) * (1.18 if month in (1, 2) else 1) - r['PATIENT_SAVINGS_USD'] * 0.6)) if r['NEW_RX'] else 0.0

columns.name: ABANDONED_RX
columns.expr: (1 if chance(min(0.7, (0.045 + 0.5 * min(1.0, r['PATIENT_OOP_USD'] / 450.0) + (0.02 if month in (1, 2) else 0)) * (0.78 if r['RTPB_CHECKS'] else 1) * ((1.45 - 0.75 * ramp(270)) if r['_NAV'] else 1))) else 0) if r['NEW_RX'] else 0

columns.name: PA_REQUESTS
columns.expr: 1 if r['TRANSACTION_TYPE'] == 'Prior Authorization' else 0

columns.name: PA_CHANNEL
columns.expr: (('Touchless ePA' if chance(0.45 if actor['_TX'] else 0.18 + 0.15 * r['_PROG']) else 'Electronic (ePA)') if chance((0.24 + 0.68 * ramp(240)) if actor['_TX'] else min(0.9, actor['_EPA'] + 0.1 * r['_PROG'])) else 'Fax / Phone') if r['PA_REQUESTS'] else 'Not a PA'

columns.name: _PEND
columns.expr: 1 if r['PA_REQUESTS'] and ((r['_DAYSAGO'] <= 2 and chance(0.45)) or (r['_DAYSAGO'] <= 30 and chance(0.035 if r['PA_CHANNEL'] == 'Fax / Phone' else 0.012))) else 0

columns.name: PA_OUTCOME
columns.expr: ('Pending' if r['_PEND'] else weighted({'Approved': 70 if r['PA_CHANNEL'] == 'Fax / Phone' else 78, 'Denied': 16 if r['PA_CHANNEL'] == 'Fax / Phone' else 12, 'More Info Requested': 14 if r['PA_CHANNEL'] == 'Fax / Phone' else 10})) if r['PA_REQUESTS'] else 'Not a PA'

columns.name: PA_APPROVED
columns.expr: 1 if r['PA_OUTCOME'] == 'Approved' else 0

columns.name: PA_DECIDED
columns.expr: 1 if r['PA_REQUESTS'] and r['PA_OUTCOME'] != 'Pending' else 0

columns.name: PA_TURNAROUND_HOURS
columns.expr: ({'Fax / Phone': lognorm(22, 0.6) * (1.6 if r['SPECIALTY_MEDICATION'] == 'Yes' else 1), 'Electronic (ePA)': lognorm(5.4, 0.7) * (1.4 if r['SPECIALTY_MEDICATION'] == 'Yes' else 1), 'Touchless ePA': lognorm(0.08, 0.8)}[r['PA_CHANNEL']]) if r['PA_DECIDED'] else None

columns.name: PA_DAYS_PENDING
columns.expr: r['_DAYSAGO'] if r['_PEND'] else None

columns.name: NETWORK_LATENCY_MS
columns.expr: lognorm({'NewRx': 280, 'RxRenewal': 300, 'CancelRx': 310, 'RxChange': 330, 'Medication History': 1350, 'Eligibility': 620, 'Prior Authorization': 950, 'Clinical Direct Message': 460, 'Formulary': 520}[r['TRANSACTION_TYPE']], 0.42) + (1450 * uniform(0.6, 1.4) if r['RTPB_CHECKS'] else 0)

columns.name: _ERR
columns.expr: uniform(0, 1)

columns.name: _RJP
columns.expr: {'NewRx': 0.011, 'RxRenewal': 0.022, 'CancelRx': 0.042, 'RxChange': 0.048, 'Medication History': 0.018, 'Eligibility': 0.014, 'Prior Authorization': 0.03, 'Clinical Direct Message': 0.01, 'Formulary': 0.008}[r['TRANSACTION_TYPE']] * (1.25 if actor['EHR_VENDOR'] in ('Veradigm', 'MEDITECH') else 1)

columns.name: MESSAGE_STATUS
columns.expr: 'Rejected' if r['_ERR'] < r['_RJP'] else ('Error' if r['_ERR'] < r['_RJP'] + 0.004 else 'Delivered')

columns.name: REJECTED
columns.expr: 1 if r['MESSAGE_STATUS'] == 'Rejected' else 0

columns.name: ERRORS
columns.expr: 1 if r['MESSAGE_STATUS'] == 'Error' else 0

columns.name: MED_HISTORY_MATCHED
columns.expr: (1 if chance(0.87) else 0) if r['TRANSACTION_TYPE'] == 'Medication History' else 0
